unit: ESB transaction export string/source row or FlowBench task occurrence
candidate_interpretation: Research anomaly/review candidate, not a confirmed incident
numeric_rule_modification: New reviewed version required; no in-place threshold adjustment during detection
logical_rule_modification: Regenerate/review a new version; do not rewrite the frozen calculation silently
frozen_ML_input_contract: No extra Boolean columns without explicit retraining/validation
missing_policy: Preserve null and source/relationship uncertainty; do not replace with zero or healthy
partial_failure: Keep peer warnings and evidence; missing component remains unavailable; nonzero CLI exit

ratio_zero_policy.partition_check: SR consistency review against user-provided column definition, not source-enforced HR
